steps.name: batch-ocr-upload
steps.detail: Mathpix OCR service is not enabled or not fully configured. Configure MATHPIX_API_KEY, MATHPIX_APP_ID, and ENABLE_MATHPIX.

conclusion: SHARED_BACKEND_BLOCKER: Mathpix OCR not enabled/configured on this API origin. Mobile and web handwritten both call the same endpoint; generation cannot succeed until provider is enabled server-side.
